uncited: Domain-Specific Adaptations extend 3D Gaussian Splatting to non-photometric domains by replacing view-dependent RGB color with scalar attributes or specialized geometric intersections .

Unlike standard 3D Gaussian Splatting which optimizes for novel-view synthesis from calibrated RGB images, these methods optimize against 3D volume data, microscopy stacks, or ultrasound probe planes using domain-specific loss functions and rendering primitives .
The primitive representation, covariance parameterization, and geometric projection pipeline are inherited from [Application-Specific Extensions](13465-application-specific-extensions.md).
In radiative and domain-specific variants, this is replaced by view-independent scalar attributes or feature vectors .
